title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Tokenized asset market tops $43B as institutions accelerate blockchain adoption
summary: Tokenized financial assets have surged 37% in six months as institutions expand blockchain adoption and the market broadens beyond funds and private credit, according to Token Terminal.

title: Bitcoin metric near ‘low-risk’ zone after holders absorb 125K BTC in June: Time for a rebound?
summary: Bitcoin’s Sharpe ratio and a 125,000 BTC increase in BTC accumulator demand mark the start of a new demand phase. Will prices follow?

title: Crypto PAC has $12M stake in Senate primary runoff as Alabama voters head to polls
summary: Defend American Jobs reported spending $7.4 million on media to support Republican Barry Moore ahead of his May 20 Alabama primary, and an additional $4.7 million before Tuesday’s runoffs.

title: Coinbase lets users transfer stock portfolios as exchange expands beyond crypto
summary: The crypto exchange is deepening its push into traditional finance by enabling ACATS stock transfers and expanding trading products beyond digital assets.

title: XRP whale wallet withdrawals top 720M as risk-adjusted return data points to opportunity
summary: Whales pulled more than 720 million XRP from exchanges, as various data points converge to predict a potential 50% rally.

title: State Street launches GENIUS Act-aligned money market fund for stablecoin reserves
summary: The launch comes amid growing competition among financial institutions to manage assets backing dollar-pegged stablecoins.

title: Ripple targets Africa’s booming remittance market with Flutterwave investment
summary: Ripple’s investment in Flutterwave will bring RLUSD, Ripple Payments and XRPL to one of Africa’s largest fintechs as blockchain remittances gain traction.

title: Why US-regulated Bitcoin perpetuals could change crypto trading
summary: US-regulated Bitcoin perpetual futures could give retail and institutional traders new ways to access crypto derivatives.

title: Binance says it considers EU license compliant amid reports of potential rejection
summary: Without specifically calling out a report on Binance’s EU license, the crypto exchange warned that any rejection forcing it to delay activities in the region could “weaken liquidity” and present other potential risks.
